Trim artichokes at base. If steaming put them in for about 20min. You want them tender but not quite ready to eat. I'm not sure about a pressure cooker but I would guess ~10 minutes after the weight starts jiggling. My mom had a pressure cooker, I do not. Yet.

Meanwhile you will be making this sauce:

-Olive oil

-Freshly crushed garlic

-Lemon juice

-Salt and pepper

Once the artichokes have been softened in the pot cut them in half lengthwise. Don't cut the tips off. Baste them in the sauce and put them inside ways up on the grill in a not so hot spot. Let it smoke. When you see some brownish spots flip and baste again. Yes it will flair up. It's ok, this is BBQ. Once that side starts browning you're good to go. Baste again lightly.

These are already great on their own but the dipping sauce makes it ridiculous:

-Melted butter

-Mayonnaise

-More garlic

All whipped up. I definitely wouldn't call this recipe "healthy" but damn is it good.
